root_cause: A commit enabled FLAKY_TESTS=true in the CI workflow, causing two intentionally-broken test cases to run. Both tests fail at assertion or import time, so the test stage exits non-zero and the build is blocked. No code change broke production; the pipeline itself is the failure point.
contributing_factors: FLAKY_TESTS env var set to 'true' in workflow dispatch input
test_flaky_always_fails: hard assert False simulates a regressed test
test_flaky_import_error: imports a non-existent module simulating a removed dependency
CI exits non-zero on the test stage — build and deploy never run
evidence: GitHub Actions test job status: failure
Build job skipped (needs: test not satisfied)
No pods restarted — failure is pre-deploy

remediation.recommendation: Revert FLAKY_TESTS to false and fix or skip the broken tests before re-running the pipeline.
steps: Set FLAKY_TESTS=false in the workflow dispatch input (or remove the flag)
Fix or mark xfail the two intentionally-failing test cases
Confirm test and build stages both pass
